title: Interrogating Design Homogenization in Web Vibe Coding

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis of academic and gray literature, combined with methodical walkthroughs of AI vibe-coding platforms, to identify default behaviors that impose Western-centric aesthetics and override regional design preferences.
Sociotechnical risk analysis mapping representational harms to the web vibe-coding lifecycle, specifically identifying stereotyping risks in generated site content, names, or images.
